# K GraphFuse

> Sparse graph polynomial plans, directional sensitivities and optional CUDA execution. Created by Utkarsh Sinha. Evaluation release 0.1.0; Apache 2.0 with preserved historical MIT components.

Published native ranking study: 59/89 strong speed wins; 26/89 also have both reference errors no worse. There are 85 comparable cases and four K accuracy failures. Strongest tested control wins: 33/85 overall, 38/85 GPU. Separate precision GPU experiment: 6/6 speed and sampled-accuracy gates, 1.25–3.74x versus FP64 CuPy/PyTorch on constructed filters and derivatives; not native cuGraph. Frozen timed source and later checked-API source are separate. Full-workflow losses, unsupported algorithms and all candidates remain visible. Global SOTA, energy and customer savings are unestablished. The original one-run 21.28% native result and historical zero-pass 19-workload suite are retained under their original contracts.
